# Snapshot sample

This is what an Obsidian snapshot looks like to Personakind: a plain text file that ends in .md.
Obsidian keeps every note as one of these files in your vault folder. Nothing in it runs, nothing is
uploaded; the page reads the text and places it in the facet and cell you choose, and it is saved
when you press Save.

## What to put in one

- How you make decisions, in your own words.
- What you will and will not do.
- The rules you hold yourself to.
- How you sound when you write.

## Size

Up to 40,000 characters per file. Split a longer note into two.
